summary: Tested the Infobip countries on CloudIVR web Get a number, backend and frontend, in preview dry-run. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass. The catalog lists all 12 instant and 11 request countries with the right provider, details and localOnly values. The FR search returns surcharge 0 and the FR buy charges the plan price only, with the number saved as provider infobip. The AU search returns the request object. POST /numbers/request returns 400 for GB, 400 for a bad plan, 428 without saved details, 402 with a low wallet and 202 'submitted' with one debit. The request was 'active' about 100s later with a phone number, the number shows in /numbers with provider infobip, and there was no second debit. US search and buy still work. Frontend: AU shows the plan picker and the request-order card. The pay button reads 'Order for $75.00' and changes to $50.00 when Starter is picked, and the details note is correct. DE and CY show the local note; AT, SE and DK do not and have the right details text. Ordering shows the toast and refreshes the wallet. France results checkout at $50.00 and go to the number page. The gate (buy-profile-gate) shows for the user without details on US and AU. One UI bug: the 'Numbers on order' list does not appear right after ordering, only after a page reload.

minor.issue: Refunds the wallet even when updateOne matched 0 docs (status already active/refunded), so a repeat or concurrent call could refund twice. Credit only when modifiedCount === 1.

No atomic claim of the request before activating it (e.g. findOneAndUpdate to status 'activating'). If a tick overlaps another tick, or a second pod runs, the same request could be activated twice. singletonInterval reduces this risk but does not remove it.
Dry-run numbers for non-AU countries use a fake '+99' prefix (not a valid country code). Preview only.

ui_bugs.issue: After a successful order, the 'Numbers on order' list (pending-requests) does not appear until the page is reloaded. useApi('/numbers/requests') is fetched only on mount and onDone only calls setRes(null). Fix: have onDone call PendingRequests' reload (lift the state up or use a key/refresh token).

design_issues.screen: Buy page, request countries with details 'none' (AT/CR/DO/EC/PE/PY)
issues: For a user without saved details, the page shows the request-order card instead of buy-profile-gate, but the backend gate still returns 428. The global 'Who is this number for?' modal does appear, so it works, but it is inconsistent with AU/SE, which show the inline gate. Either show the gate for every country or exempt 'none' countries in the backend gate.

action_items: Refresh PendingRequests after a request order (pass a reload callback or key) so 'Numbers on order' shows right away
Make the refund in number-requests.js conditional on modifiedCount === 1
Claim requests atomically in tick()/activate() to prevent a double activation
Optional: make the profile gate the same for 'none'-details request countries in the UI and backend
critical_code_review_comments: number-requests.js refund(): wallet credit is unconditional, so a double refund is possible

activate(): if numbersApi.purchase fails, the request stays 'submitted'/'approved' and is retried every tick with no limit, no customer notice and no refund. Consider a max-attempts setting followed by a refund.
PendingRequests is not refreshed after ordering
